title: Ing Kusang Sakripisyu
intro: keng panaun ning banal a pamagsubuk, ing metung a kaladwa meyaus ya keng katataulian a dapat ning pamagpasakop. Meragul ya keng gabun a alang tanaman, ining pigura meragul ya para mika kasalpantayanan ampo pasensya. Inyang ing metung a vision inutus na ing miyain lang ain, e la mig-abala. Ing karelang istorya metung yang pundasyun ning debosyon.
clues: Aku ing pakibat king malambat nang panayan a panalangin ning metung a dakilang propeta.
Ikami ning ima ku mitagan kami keng metung a alang tau a libis na atin mung probisyon a petsa ampo danum.
Meragul kung propeta a kilala king kanakung katapatan at kapibabatan.
Sinaup ku kang tatang ku para itas ing pundasyun ning metung a sagradung bale a makadedika kang Allah.
Inyang sinabi na kanaku ning tata ku ing paninap na ban iyain na ku, ngakung mekibat, Daptan mu ing inutus da keka.
Peparangal ne ning Allah ing kanakung pamagpasakup kapamilatan ning peparala yang metung a lalaking tupa ibat banua ban atbusan na ku.

arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast." (37:102)
